label: SmartNode SN4141E VoIP gateway
description: Ruggedized DIN-rail SmartNode gateway with 4 RJ-11 FXS ports (also offered as 2 FXS + 2 FXO, or 8 FXS) and one 10/100/1000BASE-T gigabit Ethernet port for the IP side.
notes: Patton ordering table: SN4141E/4JS4V/DC is 4 FXS, 4 VoIP calls, 1x Gig Ethernet; the /2JS2V/DC, /4JS4JO8V/DC and /8JS8V/DC variants also carry 1x Gig Ethernet, while the /2ETH... SKUs add a second gigabit port. This spec models the 4 FXS / 1x Gig Ethernet build. FXS/FXO ports are analog telephony and not modelled. Powered by 12-48 VDC terminal block (no PoE), eSBC upgradeable to 200 SIP calls, T.38 fax, SIP-TLS/SRTP optional, managed by web GUI, SNMP and CLI.
